senses.gloss: कुभृत् m. A mountain or a king.

कुभा The Kābul river (falling into the Indus); मा वो रसानितभा
 कुभा Rv. 5. 53. 9.

कुभ्रामि a. Refractive of light; Kau. A. 2. 11. Probably an error in parsing. Should be tarkuBrAmi.^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260704. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/286.
